title: Fix MyPy type errors in airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dag.py for Sqlalchemy 2 migration
body:
related: #56735
1. airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dagbag.py
2. airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dag.py

mypy errors:

  airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dagbag.py:75: error: Need type annotation for
  "info"  [var-annotated]
              info = inspect(dag_run)
                     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dagbag.py:81: error: Incompatible return value
  type (got "DagVersion | None", expected "DagVersion")  [return-value]
              return session.get(DagVersion, dag_run.created_dag_version_id)
                     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dag.py:139: error: Argument 2 to
  "infer_automated_data_interval" has incompatible type "datetime | None";
  expected "datetime"  [arg-type]
          return infer_automated_data_interval(timetable, run.logical_date)
                                                          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dag.py:525: error: Incompatible types in
  assignment (expression has type "set[Any]", variable has type
  "Result[tuple[str]]")  [assignment]
              paused_dag_ids = {paused_dag_id for (paused_dag_id,) in paused...
                               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~...
  airflow-core/src/airflow/models/dag.py:526: error: Incompatible return value
  type (got "Result[tuple[str]]", expected "set[str]")  [return-value]
              return paused_dag_ids
                     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~

files.patch:
@@ -141,6 +141,8 @@ def get_run_data_interval(timetable: Timetable, run: DagRun) -> DataInterval:
 
     # Compatibility: runs created before AIP-39 implementation don't have an
     # explicit data interval. Try to infer from the logical date.
+    if run.logical_date is None:
+        raise ValueError("Cannot infer data interval: run.logical_date is None")
     return infer_automated_data_interval(timetable, run.logical_date)
 
 
@@ -521,13 +523,13 @@ def get_paused_dag_ids(dag_ids: list[str], session: Session = NEW_SESSION) -> se
         :param session: ORM Session
         :return: Paused Dag_ids
         """
-        paused_dag_ids = session.execute(
-            select(DagModel.dag_id)
-            .where(DagModel.is_paused == expression.true())
-            .where(DagModel.dag_id.in_(dag_ids))
+        paused_dag_ids = set(
+            session.scalars(
+                select(DagModel.dag_id)
+                .where(DagModel.is_paused == expression.true())
+                .where(DagModel.dag_id.in_(dag_ids))
+            )
         )
-
-        paused_dag_ids = {paused_dag_id for (paused_dag_id,) in paused_dag_ids}
         return paused_dag_ids
 
     @property

@@ -208,13 +208,23 @@ def set(
                 "this message. See Dynamic Task Mapping documentation for "
                 "more information about lazy proxy objects."
             )
-            log.warning(
-                warning_message,
-                "return value" if key == XCOM_RETURN_KEY else f"value {key}",
-                task_id,
-                dag_id,
-                run_id,
-            )
+            if key == XCOM_RETURN_KEY:
+                log.warning(
+                    warning_message,
+                    "return value",
+                    task_id,
+                    dag_id,
+                    run_id,
+                )
+            else:
+                log.warning(
+                    warning_message,
+                    "value %s",
+                    task_id,
+                    dag_id,
+                    run_id,
+                    key,
+                )
             value = list(value)
 
         if serialize:
